thread:
Leah: Quick heads-up — we need to lock SI enablement for the Marketplace + HW partners before the joint announcement next Tue. Who can own lab token distribution and voucher tracking?
Tom: I can take voucher tracking. Do we have a canonical CSV for the batch?
Ravi: I have the CSV but need the upload path and who will redeem. cc @Cecilia for redemption flow.
Cecilia: Redemption flow is ready — redeem UI is at https://si.redwood.example/redeem. Need voucher prefix (eg RW-SI-2026).
Sara: I'll own lab tokens (sandbox access). Planning to spin up 100 seats with preloaded LLM image. ETA EOD tomorrow.
AJ: Can we gate tokens to only certified SIs? We should wire that to the cert roster.
Leah: Yes. Certification roster is the source of truth. @AJ can you sync with training team to enable an API check?
AJ: Yep. We'll add a simple lookup endpoint: `GET /api/v1/si/{org_id}/cert_status`. Need a list of org IDs from partnerships.
Tom: Voucher CSV -> `partner_org,contact_email,qty,org_id` sample is ready. Ravi, pls upload to shared bucket when done.
Ravi: Uploaded to gs://redwood-shared/si-vouchers/2026-03-xx/vouchers.csv
ops-bot: File gs://redwood-shared/si-vouchers/2026-03-xx/vouchers.csv validated (rows: 78) :white_check_mark:
Cecilia: I'll wire the redemption UI to call cert_status before allowing redemption. Quick question — what should the voucher expiration be?
Leah: Let's set 90 days from issue for this launch. Keeps us flexible.
Sara: Lab image is `rw/si-sandbox:2026-03-15`. Will push to registry in 2 hours.
Tom: Marketplace listing copy needs final approval from marketing. I've pasted the draft here: https://docs.google.com/draft/si-marketplace-copy — can someone take a pass?
Ravi: LGTM with minor edits to the integration bullet. I'll add hardware compatibility notes for the HW partners.
Leah: Important: coordinated announcement checklist (short):
```
- Confirm lab seats + image pushed (owner: Sara)
- Voucher CSV uploaded + tracking sheet shared (owner: Tom)
- Cert API active + roster synced (owner: AJ)
- Marketplace copy + logos signed off (owner: Marketing / Tom)
- Joint PR draft and asset drop (owner: Partnerships / Leah)
- SI enablement webinar scheduled (owner: Training / Ravi)
```
Ravi: I'll schedule the enablement webinar for Wed (recorded) and set an office hours slot on Thu. Will post invite link later.
Cecilia: For hardware partners — can we include a single-page compatibility matrix in the marketplace listing? That reduces support churn.
Leah: Yes please. Ravi, add that to the webinar deck. Tom, can you collect logos and the one-pager for marketing?
Tom: On it. Sending a shared folder in 30m. @marketplace-bot please run a quick assets checklist when Tom uploads.
marketplace-bot: Watching folder /shared/si-assets/ (will report missing logos after upload)
Sara: Quick FYI — lab quota bump request submitted to infra for +200 GPUs for the week of announcement. Ops will confirm.
ops-bot: Quota request ticket #INC-8242 created, ETA approval 24h.
Leah: Thanks all — owners confirmed: Sara (labs), Tom (vouchers + marketplace assets), AJ (cert API), Ravi (webinar + HW notes), Leah (PR). I'll follow up in the doc with deadlines. If anyone needs to change ownership ping me. :thumbsup: 
Tom: I'll also add a small automation to mark vouchers as redeemed in the tracking sheet when UI hits the webhook. Saves manual work.
Cecilia: Perfect. That should cut down ops approvals.
Leah: OK closing here for now — I'll post the launch playbook link when it's assembled: https://docs.google.com/si-launch-playbook.
Tom: Thanks — moving to action items. :rocket:
